description: Python source code for a report parser class 'rml_parse' used in an OpenERP/Odoo module, including methods for formatting numbers, dates, and strings, and handling report headers.

classes.name: rml_parse
classes.description: A report parser class extending report_sxw.rml_parse, providing methods for formatting and string manipulation in report generation.

methods.name: comma_me
methods.description: Formats a number with thousand separators and handles zero values.

methods.name: _ellipsis
methods.description: Truncates a string to a maximum length, adding ellipsis if truncated.

methods.name: _strip_name
methods.description: Shortens a name string to a maximum length with ellipsis.

methods.name: _explode_name
methods.description: Inserts line breaks into a string to limit line length, encoding to ISO-8859-1.

methods.name: makeAscii
methods.description: Encodes a string to UTF-8 or UTF-16, handling Unicode errors.

methods.name: explode_this
methods.description: Inserts line breaks into a string at specified intervals.

methods.name: repair_string
methods.description: Attempts to fix encoding issues in a string by re-encoding characters.

methods.name: ReencodeAscii
methods.description: Decodes a string to ASCII, handling errors.

methods.name: _add_header
methods.description: Adds header HTML to report pages, including company logo.
